name: RTAM Foundation Color Tokens
$comment: v0.2.0 (2026-07-12): the substance palette — colours re-anchored to the ritual substances that touch the Lord (founder decision: Garbhagriha leads, Bhasma-day reads, Kanaka for festivals). deepIndigo and warmIvory-as-ground are RETIRED from brand surfaces; tokens kept for legacy assets until the v2 asset regeneration completes.

antiqueGold.role: DIPA — the lamp flame: god-points (bindu, suns), display type on mahakala, gold foil in print. Decorative only on light (2.03:1)

warmIvory.role: LEGACY (retired as brand ground 2026-07-12; read chrome-yellow) — existing assets only; new reading surfaces use chandraMoon

charcoalBlack.role: Ink — wordmarks and text on light surfaces; the icon body on chandra paper

sandstone.role: LEGACY (retired as panel ground 2026-07-12) — hairline separators in documents only

deepIndigo.role: RETIRED from brand surfaces (2026-07-12, founder) — legacy assets only; night now means mahakala

bronze.role: KANSYA — bell-metal (ghanta, panchaloha): large sizes and ornament on mahakala only (3.94:1)

stoneGray.role: BHASMA — vibhuti ash, mid tone: quiet marks, dividers; part of the bhasma triad

mahakala.role: MAHAKALA — the linga stone, the garbhagriha dark: the brand ground (Garbhagriha register leads all dark surfaces, city print, video)

bhasmaLight.role: BHASMA light — vibhuti ash: body text on mahakala (10.42:1 AAA)

bhasmaDeep.role: BHASMA deep — vibhuti ash: captions and metadata on mahakala (5.25:1 AA)

tamraCopper.role: TAMRA — the abhisheka copper: functional accent on light (links, CTAs; 5.65:1 on chandra, 6.07:1 on warmIvory; Pantone 1405C)

chandraMoon.role: CHANDRA — the moon on His crown: the de-yellowed reading ground (Bhasma-day register: website body, documents)
